purpose: Tripo image-to-3D reference inputs for the approved hybrid 2D exploration / first-person 3D tabletop game
visual_target: Existing approved sprites: restrained semi-realistic painted materials; ivory shirt and white mask dealer; olive/brown/gold companion; burgundy/ebony/brass round table. Single subject per image, neutral background, readable geometry.
scope: Three separate model-generation tasks. Characters are in standing A-pose for later rigging and seated animation. No scene or full tavern generation.

assets.file: 01_面具荷官_A姿势_单体建模参考.png
references: 美术资产/首批_v1/03_核心角色/面具荷官_全身六姿态透明图集.png
assets.generation_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE image-to-3D input reference for a humanoid game model, not a sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is the identity and costume reference for the masked dealer in the game's approved artwork. It contains multiple poses; use those only to understand the SAME character. Produce exactly ONE character in the output, one front view.
Primary request: reconstruct this dealer as a clean isolated full-body, straight-on front-facing neutral A-pose modeling reference, from the top of his hair to the soles of both shoes. Preserve his slim adult male proportions, softly waved side-parted brown hair, plain white porcelain full-face mask with small dark eye apertures and restrained nose shape, cream long-sleeved shirt, very dark brown fitted waistcoat with brass buttons, dark necktie, dark tailored trousers and worn dark leather shoes. Mask must be expressionless, uncracked, opaque, no mouth grin. Keep the ivory shirt sleeves rolled neatly to the forearms as in the reference. Keep costume practical and restrained. Remove the pocket-watch chain so it does not form floating geometry.
Pose and geometry readability: stand upright, legs straight and slightly apart, both feet pointing forward, arms symmetrically angled 30 degrees out from torso, elbows straight, both empty hands fully visible with anatomically correct distinct fingers relaxed and slightly separated, palms facing forward. No hands touching the body. Clothing follows body, no loose cape.
View: near-orthographic eye-level front view with minimal perspective, not top-down. One full-length figure centered with at least 8% clean margin all around, portrait 2:3 composition. Hair, fingers, and both shoes completely in frame.
Style/medium: high-quality sculptural game-character concept, restrained semi-realistic hand-painted material finish matching the project's worn wood / muted cloth / old brass world; readable volumetric anatomy and garment construction, not glossy plastic and not a photograph. Crisp silhouette and clear material boundaries, moderate detail.
Background and light: perfectly plain light neutral gray studio background, flat soft balanced lighting on all sides. No vignette, dramatic shadows, glow, floor plane, platform or environment. No cast shadow.
Strict exclusions: no chair, table, dice, cup, coins, cloth in hand, extra props, text, labels, measurements, watermark, grid, turnaround sheet, second character or duplicate view. This is an unrigged visual reference; do not draw bones or skeleton guides.
assets.tripo_prompt: A single slim adult male masked dealer, full-body neutral A-pose. Preserve the reference identity, wavy brown hair, plain white porcelain full-face mask, cream rolled-sleeve shirt, dark brown waistcoat, dark tie, dark trousers and leather shoes. Empty hands with separate fingers, separate legs, complete front and back anatomy, connected clothing, no table or props. Semi-realistic hand-painted game materials, no environment or ground plane.
assets.rig: humanoid rig required later; verify fingers, shoulders, elbows and knees
assets.pivot: ground between feet; normalize in Blender/Godot after generation
assets.collision_role: simple interaction proxy in Godot, not detailed render mesh

assets.file: 03_黑金红绒赌桌_单体建模参考.png
references: 美术资产/首批_v1/02_家具摆件/黑金赌桌与三向座椅_透明图集.png
assets.generation_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE isolated furniture image for image-to-3D reconstruction.
Input image 1 is the approved furniture style sheet. Use ONLY the circular dark red tabletop from its upper-left cell as the identity/style reference. Ignore every chair, lamp, tray, grid and background in the input. Derive the missing table support simply and coherently.
Primary request: exactly ONE complete free-standing round gambling table, presented as a clean three-quarter furniture product/model reference. Preserve the circular deep wine-red velvet playing surface, sturdy near-black aged wooden rim, restrained antique brass edge bands, brass studs and modest carved floral rim accents. The large central playing surface must be perfectly empty, flat, unmarked and unobstructed. No casino markings, printed numbers, compartments or props.
Construction: show the complete circular tabletop thickness, a single robust dark carved wooden central pedestal underneath, and a stable broad three-footed wooden base as parts of ONE connected table. Feet simple and solid, no thin fragile ornament. Approximate intended proportions: round tabletop diameter 1.6 m, height 0.76 m; this is only a proportion guide, do not print dimensions. Leave knee space under the rim for three seated people. Under-table support dark wood with small restrained antique brass accents; no other furniture.
View/framing: single 3/4 front view from a moderately elevated camera around 20 degrees above tabletop level, long-lens minimal distortion, enough surface visible to read the round tabletop and enough low-angle visibility to see the full pedestal and base. Complete table and all feet inside the frame, centered, 10% clear margin, square composition. Do not use a straight overhead view, not a sheet of views.
Style: high-quality semi-realistic hand-painted 3D-game furniture reference with clear readable volumes, coherent muted burgundy / ebony wood / old brass materials, matching the original artwork. No photoreal casino glamour or plastic.
Lighting/background: perfectly plain light neutral gray studio background, soft neutral diffuse illumination, no baked dramatic highlights, no floor plane, no cast shadow, no glow, no vignette.
Exclude: all people, chairs, dice, chips, cups, lamps, trays, other tables, duplicate views, grid, labels, lettering, numbers, watermark, floating disconnected parts.
assets.tripo_prompt: One complete round gambling table, diameter-to-height proportions approximately 1.60 m to 0.76 m. Flat empty deep burgundy velvet tabletop, thick dark aged wooden rim with restrained antique brass bands and carved accents. One connected central dark wooden pedestal and broad stable three-foot base. Round top must remain flat and circular. Complete underside and support geometry. No chairs, people, dice, chips, markings, floating parts, background or floor plane. Semi-realistic painted game materials.
